recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical triptych composition featuring a rock musician in three distinct states: a ghosted blue-tinted profile on the left, a dark atmospheric center, and a sharp, high-contrast action shot on the right holding a double-neck guitar.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division of the frame into three unequal panels
Progression from ethereal/ghosted imagery to sharp physical presence
Contrast between cool blue gradients and warm wood-grain guitar tones
Top-aligned wide-tracked typography spanning all three panels
coreInvariants: The double-neck electric guitar as a central prop
A leather jacket and denim attire
Atmospheric smoke or haze in the background
A distinct vertical line separating the sharp right panel from the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is positioned in the right third of the frame, scaled to full height from knees up, with a secondary ghosted figure in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The double-neck guitar, specifically the sunburst finish and the vertical necks, acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the wide-spaced text at the top, moves down the vertical dividing line, and settles on the musician's intense expression and the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The center panel provides significant negative space filled with dark, smoky texture to balance the busy right panel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and blacks provide the atmospheric foundation and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white is used for the typography and highlights on the leather jacket.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Amber and honey tones from the sunburst guitar finish provide a warm focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the right panel (bright skin/highlights vs dark leather) against low-saturation, mid-value blue gradients on the left.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues, blacks, and warm wood tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' lacks a crossbar in some variations, though here it is a classic geometric 'A'
Extreme letter spacing (tracking) is the defining characteristic

composition.scale: Large but delicate due to weight
composition.relationshipToImage: Floats over the background and subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking to create a horizontal band effect.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity and circular 'O' perfectly.
Provides the necessary sharp apexes and geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a triptych image. Left panel: a ghosted, blue-tinted image of a man playing guitar. Center panel: dark, smoky blue-black void. Right panel: a sharp, high-contrast photo of a man in a black leather jacket and jeans playing a sunburst double-neck guitar with a slight motion blur on his head.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the very top. Use extreme tracking so the letters span the entire width of the frame. Set color to pure white.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking wide enough to span the whole width?
Is there a clear vertical line separating the right third?
Does the left side have a distinct blue color cast?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue tint on the left
Amount of motion blur on the subject's face
Specific tracking width of the typography
The exact crop of the double-neck guitar
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the guitar is a generic double-neck model without brand logos
The face should be a generic likeness of a rock musician

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the guitar and hands in the right panel
avoid: Illegible text due to tight spacing

postGenerationChecks: Check for three distinct vertical zones
Verify the guitar has two necks
Ensure the text is perfectly horizontal and top-aligned
recipe.reuseFormula: Triptych layout + Ghosted left panel + Dark center + Sharp right action shot + Extreme-tracked geometric sans-serif header.
